assumptions.claim: Queue order is the unique monotonic enqueue sequence and finalization consumes only its current prefix.
Any caller may finalize a valid transition or trigger an expired-head escape; no operator identity is available.
ModelProofBackend establishes only interface behavior and cannot stand in for a PCS/STARK proof.
Poisson stationary independent arrivals are used only for analytic latency expectations.
A refund recipient can receive native ETH; failed transfer reverts atomically and leaves the head pending.
